stage_title: Confirmed minimal repair and local regression

constraints: Use only the approved existing Anaconda interpreter for validation
Do not install or change dependencies
Do not modify source materials or A4 records
Do not execute A5 or A7

repairs.before: Assertions treated global queue rows as if they belonged to the current year and required progress entries for years intentionally absent from the partial historical progress file.
repairs.after: Queue assertions filter by the current year where year scope is intended, global gate counts remain explicit, and progress assertions accept the documented partial status model without promoting absent years.
repairs.impact_scope: Test assertions only; queue, gate, checkpoint, progress, business data, and source bytes were not modified.

regression.command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <approved affected queue/progress nodes>

repairs.rollback: Revert only the A5-RP-013 assertion hunks from this commit; retain the A3 finding and all control inputs.

repairs.before: Year-specific unknown-content scans used errors=ignore, allowing malformed bytes to be silently discarded.
repairs.after: Year-specific scans use strict UTF-8 decoding and raise an assertion with repository-relative path, encoding, exception type, byte position, and reason on decode failure.
repairs.impact_scope: Test read policy only; no source bytes or derived business records were changed.
repairs.rollback: Revert only the A5-RP-014 decoding-policy hunks from this commit; retain the A3 finding.

repairs.before: Page and worksheet upper bounds used incomplete or hard-coded limits, and BOM/encoding behavior was not consistently separated from strict output validation.
repairs.after: Bounds are derived from representation, carrier, inspection, observed-page, missing-page, or sheet evidence; input BOM tolerance remains distinct from strict UTF-8 output checks.
repairs.impact_scope: Test assertions only; no source, business, gate, checkpoint, queue, or A4 output was modified.

regression.command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <33 approved affected nodes>

repairs.rollback: Revert only the A5-RP-015 assertion and input-policy hunks from this commit; preserve all evidence and source records.

diagnostic_only.before: 24 nodes were collected; the A4 annual run timed out at 300 seconds with exit code 124 and no terminal outcomes recorded.
diagnostic_only.after: All 24 nodes were executed independently. Current results are 21 passed, 3 existing failures, 0 skipped, 0 errors, and 0 timeouts; the three failures match the clean baseline.
diagnostic_only.scope_guard: No 2015, 2016, or 2018-2025 annual test was rerun as part of the 2017 diagnostic, and no A4 file was overwritten.
diagnostic_only.rollback: Remove only this A6 diagnostic evidence if rejected; retain the A4 timeout aggregate unchanged.
